title: A frame of beams with a moving axis: cut, drilled, printed and built from one assembly
summary: A box of 2020 placed by its ends, with blind joins, printed brackets, feet and a NEMA 17 driving a carriage along its top: the cut list from one bar, a sheet per beam, eight jigs, every printed part on one plate, 37 build steps, and a trapped nut and a plate for the wrong slots caught. Predictions only so far: nothing has been cut or printed
